rules.schedule: every 7th available daily row, close; no current partial candle; per target pair greedily select nonoverlapping observation windows, next decision at or after previous outcome known
rules.ordering: same-day double touch ambiguous unless opening already outside one barrier; no intraday reconstruction
rules.censor: missing next day or end before outcome/window; kept separately, excluded from scored outcomes
rules.metrics: four-class summed Brier, logloss, accuracy; Laplace smoothing; no independent final holdout or probability promotion
rules.status: exploratory; finite windows solely for censoring and validation, not a target date; no personal cost basis in model grid
